newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL-Techs rebound a trace, Telmex off.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL-Techs rebound a trace, Telmex off.

text.p: Technology stocks showed signs of improvement in pre-opening trading on Tuesday after being hit yesterday by a battering ram when top networking equipment company 3Com Corp warned of weak quarterly profits.
3Com Corp shares moved up 1/2 to 37-3/4, traders said, after the company lost a quarter of their value yesterday.

Intel Corp also improved, rising to 153-1/4 from its close of 151-5/8. But International Business Machines Corp was flat in pre-opening trading, keeping its losses yesterday of six to close at 142-3/4.
Mexican telephone company Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex) shares lost nearly a point to 37-1/8 from 38 after posting disappointing 1996 profits on Monday.
The former monopoly must fend off weakness in the Mexican economy as well as new rivals, analysts have said.
Shares of Reuters Holdings Plc were trading at 61-1/2, down from their Nasdaq close of 63-1/4 after the news company posted 1996 profits.

Time Warner shares rose slightly, a trader said, after its nomination of Wall Street heavies Stephen Bollanback and Gerald Greenwald to its board. A report in the Wall Street Journal that the nominations could spell debt-cutting in the future also helped give the stock a small boost, he said.
